menus.name: Signature Tasting Menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, for the whole table. Two sommelier-chosen wine pairings on request (no price published). Vegetarian and vegan versions.

menus.note: Dinner only, for the whole table.

menus.name: Early Dine menu
menus.note: Pre-booked for 6:30pm or 6:45pm only, Sunday to Wednesday in June to August and Sunday to Thursday in September to December, for non-residents.

menus.name: Three-course lunch menu
menus.note: Four courses £88. Coffee and petit fours £10 extra. From 1 October to 27 November 2026, Monday to Friday, £48 for three courses or £58 for four.

alsoTry.name: The Pool House Restaurant & Bar
alsoTry.note: The estate's casual restaurant, open for lunch and dinner; Sunday lunch £36.50 for two courses or £46.50 for three.

hotel: Lympstone Manor, Michael Caines's country house hotel on the Exe estuary
bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or with the reservations team by phone or email. Lunch is served from 12pm (last tables 2pm Monday to Thursday, 2:30pm Friday to Sunday) and dinner from 7pm (last tables 9pm, or 9:30pm Friday to Sunday).
groups: Two dining rooms can be hired privately: Mamhead seats up to 18 (14 at one boardroom table) and Berryhead up to 46. Groups choose from the set lunch, the à la carte or the signature tasting menu.
dressCode: Smart casual; no sportswear. In the evening men may like to wear a collared shirt, and smart jeans are fine.
children: Children aged five and over are welcome in the Michelin-starred restaurant, with a children's menu alongside the adults' menu. Younger children can have a light supper from 5pm to 6:30pm in the lounge, bar or terrace, or eat at the Pool House.
